description: International input-output tables compiled by the Institute of Developing Economies of the Japan External Trade Organization. The IDE-JETRO download page says the latest tables are free to download: the Asian International Input-Output Table 2005 (3.97 MB, with 453 KB technical notes), the BRICs International Input-Output Table 2005 (942 KB) and the Transnational Interregional Input-Output Table for China, Japan and Korea, 2005 (3.19 MB); input-output tables are also sold in print and on CD-ROM, which the page recommends for time series. Downloading means accepting a use agreement: IDE-JETRO keeps copyright, users get a perpetual non-exclusive right of use but may not pass the data on, sell or copy them beyond backups, may not alter the data or documents, may build derived works, and must cite the source; no guarantee is given. Coverage is Asian economies (Asian table), the BRICs, and the regions of China, Japan and Korea, for 2005 in the free files. Caveats: file formats are not stated, the free tables stop at 2005, and redistribution is barred. For simulation they trace cross-border supply chain dependencies in Asia, to model how a disaster in one country's industry spreads to others. Related catalogue records include the World Input-Output Database and FIGARO.
